Feature Request: Rep wants the account search filter default (owner vs. all) to be a persistent, per-user setting rather than a global default, since needs vary by role.
Bug: Account search defaults to 'owner' filter, causing reps who need cross-territory visibility (e.g., covering for colleagues) to miss results and think accounts don't exist.
Data Problem: System does not distinguish between a truly new customer and a recurring customer whose reorder is flagged as "new" for comp purposes, causing confusion.
UI Polish: Rep needed clarification on what 'pull through' and the color-coding (green/yellow/red) mean on the contract pricing table, suggesting a need for in-product explanation/tooltips.
Product Story: New reps need better contextual education on pricing/contract mechanics (WAC, GPO, dish pricing) directly within the product to interpret large price variances.
Workflow: Rep manually maintains an external Excel spreadsheet as her primary task/note system and copy-pastes into Pulse, indicating the current in-app note/follow-up system is insufficiently detailed for her workflow.
